annotations.title: Read one startup pitch with score, roast and decisions

description: Read one startup pitch by id. "sections" picks the parts (default all three): "pitch" (the full public pitch), "score" (AI score, six dimensions and roast; dimensions need an API key) and "decisions" (anonymised likes, passes, ratings and pass reasons). Decisions need an investor API key and are anonymised bands of distinct signed-in users (not only investors), withheld below 5 people; a withheld field is no signal. A missing, non-public or opted-out pitch answers NOT_FOUND. Each pitch returned counts 1 against the shared daily pitch allowance (0 if this caller already got it today).

sections.description: Parts to return; default all three.

name: pitchspark_get_pitch_v2

decisions.description: Anonymised decision aggregates by signed-in PitchSpark users (not only investors); readable with investor API keys only (every block reason key_required otherwise). Counts are bands ("5-9", "10-24", "25-49", "50+"); every block is withheld below min_k distinct signed-in users (the counts cover any signed-in non-owner user, not only investor accounts).

investors_considered.description: Distinct signed-in PitchSpark users (not only investors) behind the figures, as a band; null below min_k, and null while the pass rate is hidden pending review.

pass_reasons.description: Top pass reasons, shares over the listed (visible) reasons only. The team-related reasons are withheld pending review and never appear.

available.description: false when the block is withheld: fewer than min_k distinct signed-in users (below_min_k), no source data (no_data), a read failed (unavailable), or the field is hidden pending a review (hidden_pending_review).

pass_themes.description: Why-we-passed themes. The team theme is withheld pending review and never appears.
